Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the Planner misinterpreted the Wikipedia infobox data. The infobox lists the mother (Infanta Elena) and her parents (King Juan Carlos I and Queen Sofía) in the "Mother" section, while the "Grandparents" section lists the paternal grandmother (Concepción Sáenz de Tejada) and the maternal grandmother (Queen Sofía). The Planner incorrectly identified Concepción Sáenz de Tejada as the maternal grandmother by confusing the paternal grandmother with the maternal one, likely due to a misalignment of the data fields. The correct maternal grandmother is Queen Sofía of Spain.
